purpose: Runtime resilience, offline behavior, provider recovery, delivery parity, and deterministic package evidence. This gate does not claim production readiness.

modular_served.mechanics: local HTTP with byte-range support from scripts/serve_map.py

standalone_direct_open.mechanics: file:// direct open with embedded PMTiles, fonts, sprites, terrain, and runtime photos

public_staging.mechanics: exact copy of the qualified modular artifact with release provenance

packaged_release.mechanics: deterministic ZIP of exact qualified source, assets, artifacts, and evidence

vector.label: Smart map
vector.failure_behavior: explicit Smart-map failure; never substitute a remote or raster provider

satellite.label: Satellite + labels
satellite.failure_behavior: bounded probe/tile failure returns to Smart while preserving planning state
satellite.success_evidence: optional; record VERIFY_REQUIRED when the external provider cannot be independently verified

critical_behaviors: local Smart map starts with blocked optional network
route and timeline render without runtime routing
date, region, route, preview, and detail interactions use canonical trip truth
required local photos decode in preview and detail
Smart local asset failure is explicit and fail-closed
Satellite failure is observable and recovers to Smart
reload, resize, orientation, pan, zoom, panel, and provider transitions preserve planning state
modular, standalone, public, and package forms are exact-revision-bound
